pluginJson.description: Refuses the two ways a session loses authorship of the working tree: any command that would destroy content existing only there (reset --hard, checkout/switch onto a dirty tree, clean, restore, stash drop/clear, force push, rm/mv/tee/truncate/> aimed at a modified or untracked file), and any change to file content that skips Write/Edit/NotebookEdit (sed -i and the other in-place editors, redirects, tee, cp/mv/install/rsync, patch and git apply, git used as an editor, extraction and downloads into the tree, symlinks over tracked paths, shell indirection it follows into scripts and aliases, the server-side GitHub commit, and the subagent grant that would sidestep all of it)
pluginJson.name: no-work-loss
